from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

router = APIRouter(prefix="/diagnostics/crashes")

@router.get("/{crash_id}/inspect")
async def inspect_crash_telemetry(
    crash_id: str,
    crash_repo: CrashReportRepo = Depends(get_crash_report_repo),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    report = await crash_repo.get_report(crash_id)
    if not report:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Crash report not found")

    return {
        "crash_id": crash_id,
        "stacktrace": report.stacktrace,
        "ui_breadcrumbs": report.sentry_breadcrumbs,
        "device_state": report.device_attributes
    }
diagnosis: The client crash inspection endpoint fetches detailed Sentry UI breadcrumbs and device state by crash_id without verifying that report.user_id == current_user.id. Any user can view private app navigation histories, form entries, and IP addresses of other users.
